element.title: Canopy Systems & Ripcords
element.technical_details: - Dual-canopy requirement: Main and Reserve. - Main Ripcord: Located right side, chest height. - Reserve Handle: Silver Handle, Located left side, hip height. - Protocol: Reserve usage only permitted after a Main Cut-away.

element.title: Altimeter Mastery & Decision Windows
element.technical_details: - Check Cadence: Every 5 seconds during freefall. - 5,000ft: Start of the Decision Window. - 3,000ft: Absolute Mandatory Deployment Altitude.

element.title: Weather & Atmospheric Limits
element.technical_details: - Visibility: No boarding if cloud cover is below 2,000ft. - Thunderstorms: 10-mile radius clearance for Cumulonimbus formations. - Wind Limit: Maximum ground speed 20 knots.

element.title: The Stable Arch (The Banana)
element.technical_details: - Geometry: Hips pushed forward, head back, symmetrical limbs. - Objective: Prevent "Tumble" malfunctions. - Global Travel Context: Maintaining arch in varied air densities.

element.title: Toggle Steering & Landing Flares
element.technical_details: - Turning: Left/Right toggles pulled toward the waist. - Flare: Both toggles pulled simultaneously at 10ft AGL.

element.title: Line Twists & Bicycle Kicks
element.technical_details: - Correction: Grab risers and "bicycle kick" legs. - Hard Floor: If not cleared by 2,500ft, initiate Cut-Away.

element.title: The Drown Protocol (Water Landings)
element.technical_details: - Airborne Action: Unclip chest strap. - Water Contact Action: Unclip leg straps only upon touching water. - Reasoning: Prevents harness fall-out while avoiding cocooning.

element.title: Cut-Away Procedure (Total Mal)
element.technical_details: - Sequence: Look (Red Handle), Grab (Red Handle), Pull (Silver/Reserve). - Criticality: For use during total malfunction (Mal) scenarios.
